sanskrit:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥ १८-१६॥
iast:
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ
paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ 18-16
translation: Now, such being the case, verily he who — owing to his untrained understanding — looks upon his Self, which is alone (never conditioned by the engine ) as the doer he of perverted intelligence sees not.
